suites.name: Deployment Acceptance & Host Key / WORM Verification
suites.summary: Validated pre-provisioned OpenSSH host keys, out-of-band serial hashes against external trust anchors (~/.config/siem-lab/), 30-day WORM bucket lock, and detached RSA-SHA256 signatures.

suites.name: GCP Storage & Serial Console Fail-Closed Security Boundary Test
suites.summary: Verified fail-closed security boundary: missing gcloud CLI or cloud credentials halts immediately with exit code 1; silent fallback to static artifacts is strictly prohibited.

suites.name: GCP IAM Isolation & Ancestor Hierarchy Fail-Closed Security Boundary Test
suites.summary: Verified fail-closed security boundary: missing gcloud CLI or cloud credentials halts immediately with exit code 1; prohibits silent skip of ancestor policy hierarchy.

suites.name: Live Auditd Workstation Safety Guard Test
suites.summary: Verified workstation protection guard: destructive live kernel audit modifications are blocked with exit code 1 unless executed as root with --force-live-danger on a disposable VM.

suites.name: Auditd Transactional Rollback Simulation Engine
suites.summary: 6/6 stages passed: candidate syntax error trapping, service restart failure recovery, kernel status assertions, rename boundary 1 failure trapping, rename boundary 2 emergency recovery, and metadata preservation.

suites.name: Comprehensive Negative & Missing-Evidence CLI Matrix
suites.summary: 20/20 negative assertions passed proving non-zero exit codes on unlocked policies, sub-30-day retention, tampered hashes, corrupt signatures, mock GCP errors, identity spoofing, naive timestamps, duplicate hierarchy IDs, ambiguous serial records, and unstructured substring host mentions.

suites.name: Repository Security & Secret History Audit Gate
suites.summary: 4/4 security gates passed: zero prohibited filenames, zero working directory secrets/keys, zero leaked credentials across full Git commit history, and active gitignore enforcement.
